name: highlighting
description: Source blocks in five languages, chosen for the token kinds the two highlighters divide differently: comments, keywords, class and constant names, symbols, instance and global variables, interpolated strings, numbers, method definitions, regular expressions, built-in values, preprocessor directives and the bare `title` class the pre-split grammars still emit, and the type annotations one highlighter reads by identity and the other by position. It is the only anchor whose subject is COLOUR INSIDE a code block, which is the one thing the other four cannot see.
